items.caption: A single, slightly curved horizontal stroke is shown. The source identifies it as a modern redraw of the Shang oracle-script 一; an oracle-bone example records it in the numeral phrase “one ox.”
items.alt: A thick, gently curved horizontal black stroke on white.
items.selection_reason: Its visible one-stroke shape matches the source’s account of 一 as an abstract numeral graph, and the cited oracle-bone example documents numeric use.

items.caption: A single, nearly straight horizontal stroke is shown in a modern redraw labeled Shuowen seal-script 一.
items.alt: A long, straight horizontal black stroke on white.
items.selection_reason: Adds a useful seal-script example of the same one-stroke graph; it does not establish a sequence of graphic changes by itself.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redraws rather than images of inscribed artifacts. The oracle-bone example supports numeric use, but its inscription date is not specified; the available evidence also does not establish a precise sequence of graphic forms across periods.
